video.title: 9 BORING Local Side Hustles Making People Rich

summary: Johnny Robinson (Johnny & Sergio) lists nine 'boring' local side hustles: parking lot sweeping, grease trap cleaning, mobile tire mounting, porta-potty rental, dumpster rental, remote house cleaning, medical waste pickup, mobile dirty soda bartending and claw machine routes. Each gets startup cost, income claims and a named real-world company example. Recurring, legally required or high-switching-cost commercial accounts are stressed. The remote cleaning segment is the host's own paid coaching programme (Home Service Academy), and the video contains a Northwest Registered Agent sponsor read. Mostly second-hand, promotional listicle with unverified figures.

speakers.name: Johnny Robinson
speakers.description: Co-founder of Johnny & Sergio and Home Service Academy; runs local service businesses and sells coaching on remote house cleaning.

ideas.name: Commercial parking lot sweeping
ideas.one_liner: Night-time sweeping of commercial parking lots under monthly contracts with property managers.
ideas.customer: Shopping centres, apartment complexes, HOAs and their property managers
ideas.problem: Parking lots must be kept clean and presentable.
ideas.offer: Scheduled parking lot sweeping and cleaning, usually 1-5am.

acquisition_channels.details: Landing contracts with property managers is described as the hard part; method not specified.

ideas.delivery: Owner or staff ride a used ride-on sweeper at night; or start by hand with trash bags.
ideas.startup_cost: $8,000-15,000 for a used ride-on sweeper; much less if starting by hand

acquisition.how: Landing contracts with property managers is relationship-led; some B2B outreach to limited companies is possible but mostly human.

onboarding.how: Contract and site-set-up can be templated, but a site visit is likely.

delivery.how: Physical sweeping at night requires a person and machine.

billing.how: Monthly recurring invoicing is easily automated.

support.how: Complaints about missed sweeps need human response.

uk_applicability.notes: Works in the UK, where it is called car park sweeping; contracts are with facilities managers; the sweeper costs and permits differ.

quotes.text: it's all commercial accounts. Why I love commercial accounts when you're talking about starting a service-based business like this one, commercial is going to be much stickier
quotes.speaker: Johnny Robinson

ideas.name: Grease trap cleaning
ideas.one_liner: Pump and clean restaurant grease traps on a legally required recurring schedule.
ideas.problem: Restaurants are legally required to have grease traps pumped and cleaned regularly.
ideas.offer: Scheduled grease trap pumping with a vacuum truck.

acquisition_channels.details: Knock on ~100 doors and look for restaurants unhappy with their current provider; first jobs can be free to gather testimonials.

quote.text: I bet you if you go knock on 100 doors, you're going to get a couple people that are like, "Yeah, they charge too much."
quote.speaker: Johnny Robinson

acquisition_channels.details: Direct mail mentioned as an alternative.

ideas.delivery: Operator drives a vacuum truck to each restaurant on schedule.
ideas.startup_cost: $10,000-20,000 for a used vacuum truck and certifications

acquisition.how: Door-to-door recommended; direct mail or cold email to restaurant companies could be software-driven but weak.

onboarding.how: Agreements can be e-signed; site check needed.

support.how: Scheduling and missed-visit issues need a human.

uk_applicability.notes: UK food businesses also need grease management and waste carrier licensing; the regulatory regime and licences differ.

quotes.text: you do have to get certified to start this business, but once you do, it's very simple. Um you get a vacuum, a truck, and you start signing some restaurant accounts.
quotes.speaker: Johnny Robinson

ideas.name: Mobile tire mounting and balancing
ideas.one_liner: Portable tire mounting rig serving fleets, dealerships and homes.
ideas.problem: Taking vehicles to a tyre shop costs time and employee hours.

price_points.label: Claimed income with a few fleet contracts

acquisition_channels.details: Cold email local rental, logistics and office-based companies offering on-site service deals.

quote.text: Be very easy to set up a cold email campaign, find all of your local rental companies, logistics companies
quote.speaker: Johnny Robinson

ideas.delivery: Operator drives to site with portable rig.
tools: Portable tire mounting and balancing rig

acquisition.how: Cold email to limited-company fleets is legal in the UK and automatable.

onboarding.how: Fleet onboarding via forms and quotes.

support.how: Booking and queries can be agent-handled.

uk_applicability.notes: Mobile tyre fitting exists in the UK; vehicle and rig regulations differ.

quotes.text: a rental company with 20 vehicles pays you every time any of those tires need work
quotes.speaker: Johnny Robinson

ideas.name: Porta-potty rental
ideas.one_liner: Rent, service and collect portable toilets for construction sites and events.
ideas.customer: Construction sites, event organisers, festivals, school fairs
ideas.problem: Sites and events need portable restrooms.
ideas.offer: Delivery, weekly pumping and pickup of units.

pricing.notes: Events are weekend or two-week hires.

acquisition_channels.details: Not specified beyond landing construction accounts.

ideas.delivery: Operator drops off, pumps weekly and collects units with a truck.
ideas.startup_cost: About $3,000 per unit; start with 5-10 units; cheaper if imported from China

acquisition.how: Builders and event organisers reachable via SEO and B2B outreach but relationship-driven.

uk_applicability.notes: Portable toilet hire is common in the UK; waste carrier licence and disposal rules apply.

quotes.text: One site might be paying you like $400 to $800 a month for the same unit on autopilot the entire length of the project.
quotes.speaker: Johnny Robinson

ideas.name: Dumpster rental
ideas.one_liner: Roll-off dumpster hire to contractors and homeowners.
ideas.customer: Contractors, restoration companies, homeowners doing renovations
ideas.problem: Renovation and clean-out jobs generate waste that needs hauling.
ideas.offer: Drop off a dumpster, collect when full, haul to the dump.

acquisition_channels.details: Build relationships with general contractors and remediation and restoration companies.

quote.text: how you're going to win is by building contractor relationships
quote.speaker: Johnny Robinson

ideas.delivery: Truck delivers roll-offs, hauls full ones to the transfer station.
unit_economics_claims: Bin There Dump That franchisees over $2M/year in some cases
ideas.startup_cost: Tens of thousands with a truck; $2-5k per used dumpster; can start by renting and re-renting

acquisition.how: SEO and local search work for skip hire; contractor relationships are human.

support.how: Agents can handle bookings and queries.

uk_applicability.notes: UK equivalent is skip hire; needs waste carrier registration and road permits for skips on public highways.

quotes.text: Remediation companies and restoration companies are also going to be great partners.
quotes.speaker: Johnny Robinson

ideas.name: Remote house cleaning business
ideas.one_liner: Run a cleaning company from a laptop, subcontracting independent cleaners and keeping 50-60% of revenue.
ideas.business_model: Per-job margin on cleans, recurring bookings
ideas.offer: Booked and managed residential cleaning delivered by partner cleaners.

pricing.model: Per clean; cleaner paid 40-50% of booking

acquisition_channels.details: Host says you can market wherever you want; specific channels not detailed in this video.

ideas.delivery: Independent cleaners with their own equipment and vehicles do the work; owner handles marketing, booking, communication and scheduling.

acquisition.how: Local SEO and paid ads automate well; no cold DMs needed.

delivery.how: Cleaning is physical via subcontractors; vetting, dispatch and quality issues need human oversight.

billing.how: Card payments and subcontractor payouts can be automated.

support.how: Agents handle rescheduling; complaints need escalation.

uk_applicability.notes: Works in the UK, but subcontractor employment status (IR35/self-employed rules) and insurance need care.

risks: Host sells coaching so figures are promotional

quotes.text: You partner with independent cleaners who already have their own equipment and vehicles, um and then you send them to the jobs.
quotes.speaker: Johnny Robinson

quotes.text: one in every three first-time customers converts to a recurring booking
quotes.speaker: Johnny Robinson

ideas.name: Medical waste pickup
ideas.one_liner: Licensed collection of biohazard waste from clinics, dentists and tattoo parlours.
ideas.customer: Dental offices, clinics, tattoo parlours, medspas
ideas.problem: Biohazard waste must legally be removed by a certified hauler.

acquisition_channels.details: Cold email to clinics and dental chains.

ideas.delivery: Licensed driver collects on a route using a certified truck.

acquisition.how: Cold email to limited-company clinics is legal; sole-trader practices are restricted, and contracts need relationship building.

uk_applicability.notes: UK has clinical waste regulation (hazardous waste carriers, ADR driver licences), which is stricter and the licensing differs.

quotes.text: Every single one of them is legally required to have it removed by a certified hauler.
quotes.speaker: Johnny Robinson

ideas.name: Mobile dirty soda bartender
ideas.one_liner: Serve dirty sodas at weddings and parties as an alcohol-free mobile bar.
ideas.problem: Growing demand for non-alcoholic drink experiences.
ideas.offer: Mobile dirty soda and mocktail service at events.

acquisition_channels.details: Example business Fizz N' Flirt shows its work on Instagram.

ideas.delivery: Operator staffs the event and mixes drinks.
unit_economics_claims: Fizz N' Flirt guessed at least $10k/month by host from Instagram

acquisition.how: Social content and local SEO can be automated.

delivery.how: A person must serve at the event.

uk_applicability.notes: Dirty soda is a Utah trend with little UK awareness; ingredients and demand differ, though mocktail bars exist.

quotes.text: I don't know how much revenue they're generating, but I'd imagine it's at least $10,000 a month based on what I can tell from their Instagram.
quotes.speaker: Johnny Robinson

ideas.name: Claw machine routes

ideas.offer: Owner places and maintains machines for a revenue split.

pricing.notes: Margins claimed 50-80% after prizes, rent and maintenance.

acquisition_channels.details: Negotiate placement deals in person with venue owners; not explicitly stated.

ideas.delivery: Operator buys machines, places them, restocks prizes and collects cash.
unit_economics_claims: First machine $600 from Facebook Marketplace, paid back in 4 months
ideas.startup_cost: $3,000-8,000 per machine all-in; one story started with a $600 used machine

acquisition.how: Venue placement is negotiated in person.

delivery.how: Physical servicing, restocking and cash collection.

billing.how: Revenue is cash collected on site; cashless machines help.

support.how: Fault reports via QR code to agents.

uk_applicability.notes: Works with UK amusement venues, but gaming and prize rules (Gambling Act, skill vs chance) and permits apply.

lessons.lesson: Favour customers who are legally required to buy the service, since demand is non-discretionary.

quote.text: they literally, legally, by law, have to use some type of service like this
quote.speaker: Johnny Robinson

lessons.lesson: Commercial contracts are stickier than residential and produce recurring revenue.
High switching costs make revenue sticky and retention easy.
Unglamorous niches have less competition than trendy online businesses.
Start small with whatever equipment you have and reinvest to upgrade.
Fleet or multi-site accounts concentrate repeat work and justify the sales effort.
Most businesses reduce to taking payments and recruiting/staffing, so pick one and start.
Company-size claims for named examples are unverified and none of this is agent-run: nearly all ideas are physical delivery.

evidence_quality.rationale: Second-hand listicle with rounded, unverified figures and named companies given as examples; only the cleaning segment is first-hand and it is promotional. Host admits guessing one revenue number.
evidence_quality.promotional_conflict: Host sells Home Service Academy coaching for remote cleaning businesses; the video includes a Northwest Registered Agent sponsor read.
